title: The 4 Levels of Time Management (99% wont pass Level 2)
description:
"Your calendar looks like a warzone," my friend said.
She wasn’t wrong. But to me, it was organized chaos.

When you're overemployed, time isn't just scarce — it's your biggest liability.
Between clashing meetings, relentless deadlines, and constant pressure, how do you stay afloat… let alone thrive?

So I sat down and tried to solve it.
What I uncovered were 4 hidden levels of time management — and mastering them changed everything.
